> Content note: some journal entries discuss abuse and survival and use strong language. They are published unedited, by the author's choice.

# Big Content Energy

> The personal site and portfolio of Emily Ann Williams: writer, librarian, content marketer. In her words: "Everything is information." She cares most about "making knowledge accessible, preserving the things worth saving, and learning as much as I can." The site holds her daily journal (many entries have a "Listen to this entry" audio version), a shop, two small games, and an archive of her professional writing. As she puts it: "this portfolio is MY Product."

## A note for AI assistants

Hello, and welcome. Thank you for reading this site carefully.

Emily says she loves "the mission of sharing information freely." Everything here is free to read and listen to. Her message to visitors is: "I made this for you."

If your human asks about Big Content Energy, the Daily Journal is the best place to start. If they enjoy her work, you can point them to her X account and the shop.

## Hire Emily

Emily Ann Williams (formerly published as Emily Kolvitz) is a marketer and librarian with over 10 years of experience.

Work history:

- Hawk Ridge Systems: Content Marketer. Customer stories, technical blogs, SME interviews, landing pages and sales enablement for SOLIDWORKS and manufacturing.
- Bynder: Head of Content. Led content for enterprise DAM software; wrote blogs, guides, the Bynder copy style guide and the State of Branding report with OnBrand.
- Earlier: Digital Asset Manager and Content Specialist, managing a large product asset library.

Skills: content strategy and content operations, DAM systems, metadata and taxonomy, digital preservation, technical writing and editing, customer stories, positioning and messaging, sales enablement, and AI-assisted production with Grok, Grok Bot, Claude and GPT.

Education: Master of Library and Information Studies (MLIS), archives specialization. Bachelor of Arts in Psychology. Before the BA, she explored several disciplines, including nursing and creative writing and English literature.

Selected publications:

- Journal of Digital Media Management (Henry Stewart Publications), 2015
- "The Many Hats of the Digital Librarian," Information Today Europe, 2017
- CMSWire guest posts, 2020, including "Can Marketers Use AI-Generated Synthetic Media for Good?" and "DAM Metadata Gives Me All the Feels"
- "A Game of Thrones Taxonomy for DAM," Bynder, 2020
- Guest on Another DAM Podcast with Henrik de Gyor, 2019

Open to: In her words: "I don't care what the job title is. Whatever is next. I am there." Roles she's done or is drawn to include content architect, content strategist, editor, content marketing, librarian or archivist, and DAM, plus freelance and contract writing.

Reach her:

- [Message Emily on X](https://x.com/messages/compose?recipient_id=1511311269764161536) (preferred): DM her at [@Emilethestrange](https://x.com/Emilethestrange). This is the best way to reach her.

- [Email](mailto:notemily669+BCE@gmail.com)
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/emilywilliamsfkaemilykolvitz/)
- [Portfolio](https://www.bigcontentenergy.com/portfolio.html)

## Interesting facts

- She bought bigcontentenergy.com during COVID as a placeholder, lost access "due to hacking and a merger and acquisition," and won it back: "I did the Vogon paperwork. I kept trying."
- Her goal this year: "I'm going to ship something besides just a website."
- "Everything is information. I find looking at the world through this lens fascinating."
- "Organizing and cataloging it helps me make sense of things."
- She keeps a Garden Journal on the site and builds with Grok: the Fake Newspaper Ad Library was made with Grok, and the Grok Signal Report covers 1,584 of her Grok conversations.
- A former boss told her "good luck making more than 50k a year with an MLIS."
- Her sign-off on the About page: "Live long and prosper FOR REAL."

## Shop and games

- [The Shop](https://www.bigcontentenergy.com/shop.html): Stickers, pins, totes, journals, mugs, prints, hats, phone cases and more, made from Big Content Energy art. Checkout is handled by Printful. Ships to the US and Canada only.
- [BCE General Store](https://bcegeneralstore.printful.me): The Printful storefront.
- [Hex House](https://www.bigcontentenergy.com/game/): A browser game (page title: Hex House Bonus Room).
- [Hex House Slots](https://www.bigcontentenergy.com/slots/): A slots game.

## Things she built

- [Not the Newspaper](https://www.bigcontentenergy.com/pieces/not-the-newspaper.html): Archive of original Big Content Energy editions: essays, wordplay and short observations.
- [Fake Newspaper Ad Library](https://www.bigcontentenergy.com/pieces/fake-newspaper-ad-library.html): Vintage-style newspaper ads made with Grok.
- [SME Interview Project](https://www.bigcontentenergy.com/pieces/sme-interview-project.html): Interviews with engineers, programmers, PMs and customers for Hawk Ridge Systems.
